items.title: Maria Prata, Lóli e a arte de cultivar o futuro
items.title_zh: Maria Prata ， Lóli和培育未来的艺术
items.summary: Quando soube que a filha Marta estava grávida, Laura Góes teve uma preocupação urgente: não havia uma goiabeira no quintal de sua casa, no Itaim, em São Paulo. "Como é que eu vou ter um neto e não tenho uma árvore para ele subir? Não é admissível", lembra. Plantou a goiabeira, o neto cresceu e subiu nela, e até o menino da casa vizinha passou a usá-la como caminho. Hoje, aos 96 anos, Laura, mais conhecida como Lóli, continua achando perfeitamente natural que uma criança precise de uma árvore. Sua neta Maria Prata, por outro lado, vive num mundo em que é preciso fazer um documentário para lembrar às pessoas por que a natureza importa. Leia mais (10/31/2026 - 23h00)

items.title_zh: 车辆路缘石、在家办公等：从今天起，德里将进入全污染巡逻模式
items.summary: Starting from November 1, the Delhi government will implement strict pollution control measures lasting until January 31. These initiatives will encompass vehicle-entry limitations, reduced office attendance, and increased parking fees. To mitigate dust emissions, outdoor construction will face grave restrictions during winter. Residents and vehicle owners are urged to comply to enhance city air quality. Furthermore, traffic patterns will be adjusted to reroute through-traffic away from Delhi.

While Kohli focused on attacking intent and finished with high-intensity sprints, Rohit had a light-hearted Karan Aujla moment with local cricketers.

Many protesters from different states have arrived to raise concerns about the electoral process, particularly regarding Electronic Voting Machines.

items.title: US senators write to Google CEO Sundar Pichai with 9 questions on classroom AI push

They highlighted concerns regarding the integration of AI products in schools and their potential negative impacts. The senators have set a deadline for a response by November 2, 2026. They specifically seek information on research conducted about AI's impact on children’s mental health.

items.title: Ahmedabad artist recreates Rani ki Vav with nails, thread, enters record book
items.title_zh: 艾哈迈达巴德艺术家用钉子和线重现Rani ki Vav ，进入记录簿
items.summary: In a remarkable fusion of tradition and modernity, Payal Kintu Thakkar from Gujarat has ingeniously recreated the iconic Rani ki Vav using innocuous materials like nails and cotton thread. Spanning an impressive 56 inches by 38 inches, her artwork, now recognized by the India Book of Records, captivates with its unique approach, reminding everyone of the intricate beauty of this UNESCO World Heritage Site.

Following a recent theft reported by Gangam Bhaskar Reddy, whose residence was violated during his family vacation, Jaya emerged as a suspect. Authorities believe she may be linked to five incidents in various areas of Hyderabad.

items.title: Binance to resume withdrawals after recovering 95% of $6.3 billion crypto theft

items.summary: Binance has announced a phased resumption of cryptocurrency withdrawals following a significant heist of $6.3 billion. The exchange reported it has recovered 95% of the stolen digital assets, enabling this process. The remaining 5% consists of less liquid tokens, which may require additional time to source. The FBI is investigating the cyberattack, linking it to a North Korean hacking group named TraderTraitor.

items.title: Greek shipwreck's 2,000-year-old device was built to predict eclipses

items.summary: In 1900, a remarkable discovery was made when divers stumbled upon the Antikythera Mechanism amidst a shipwreck in the Mediterranean Sea. This ancient artifact showcased astounding knowledge of astronomy and mechanical engineering dating back over 2,000 years. Researchers found it capable of calculating astronomical cycles and predicting eclipses, intertwining science with the cultural tapestry of ancient Greece.

items.title_zh: 在案件激增近17倍的情况下，政府不会收紧对非法外国派送乘客的控制
items.summary: The government is moving to tighten enforcement against foreign delivery riders working illegally and the delivery company systems that let them slip through, amid a nearly 17-fold surge in the number of violators caught. Last week, the Ministry of Justice said it held talks with the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, the Ministry of Employment and Labor, the National Police Agency and the Korea Coast Guard on a joint government response to illegal delivery work by foreign nationals. To root out the practice, the justice ministry plans to step up joint crackdowns with the police agency and expand cooperation in investigating related offenses, such as organized illegal hiring and brokering by delivery agencies, unlicensed driving and the unauthorized use of accounts registered under other people’s names. The justice ministry also plans to work with relevant agencies to build an identity verification system for riders, improve systems for managing and inspecting delivery agencies and encourage the industry to prevent illegal practices. items.title: Sejong University team finds link between retail investor attention, lower stock returns
items.title_zh: 世宗大学团队发现散户投资者的关注与较低的股票回报之间存在联系
items.summary: A research team at Sejong University has found that stocks attracting greater attention from retail investors tend to generate lower returns in subsequent periods. The university said the findings were published last month in the prestigious Journal of International Financial Markets, Institutions & Money. The team was led by Lee Eun-mi, a professor at the university’s College of Business and Economics, and included doctoral students Yang Pujian and Yang Liu. The paper, titled “The Retreat of Arbitrage Capital: Attention Level and Nonlinear Order Flow Dynamics,” lists Yang Pujian as the first author, Lee as the corresponding author and Yang Liu as a co-author. The research team examined how retail investor attention affects institutional trading behavior and stock market returns. The researchers analyzed data from China’s A-share market spanning 2012 to 2024 and measured investor attention using the Search Volume Index (SVI) provided by Baidu, China’s leading search engine. items.title: Saudi Arabia issues red and orange alerts as thunderstorms, dense fog affect several regions
items.title_zh: 沙特阿拉伯发布红色和橙色警报，因为雷暴，浓雾影响多个地区
items.summary: JEDDAH — Red and orange weather alerts have been issued across several regions, as dense fog and moderate to heavy thunderstorms are expected to affect several Saudi regions, according to the National Center for Meteorology (NCM). The NCM issued two red alerts for dense fog in parts of the Eastern Province, alongside orange alerts for fog in other parts of the region. Orange alerts for moderate rainfall have also been issued across parts of the Northern Borders, Hail, Makkah, Asir, Al-Baha and Jazan. According to the NCM’s Sunday forecast, moderate to heavy thunderstorms capable of causing flash floods, accompanied by showers of hail, are expected across parts of Jazan, Asir, Al-Baha, Makkah, Madinah, Hail and the Northern Borders. Active surface winds stirring up dust and sand are also forecast over parts of these regions, as well as parts of Riyadh and Al-Qassim. For temperatures, Dammam is forecast to record the highest temperature at 38°C, followed by Makkah at 37°C and Riyadh, Jeddah and Buraidah at 36°C. Madinah and Jazan are expected to reach 35°C, followed by Hail at 31°C, Najran at 30°C, Sakaka at 29°C, Tabuk at 28°C, Arar at 27°C, Abha at 25°C and Al-Baha at 23°C. Humidity is forecast to reach 95 percent in Abha, followed by 90 percent in Dammam, Al-Baha and Arar, and 80 percent in Hail and Sakaka. Jazan is expected to record 75 percent humidity, followed by Jeddah at 70 percent, Makkah at 65 percent, Madinah at 60 percent, Tabuk at 55 percent, Buraidah and Najran at 35 percent, and Riyadh at 30 percent.

items.title: Prince Fahd bin Jalawi represents Saudi Crown Prince at Dakar 2026 Youth Olympics opening ceremony
items.title_zh: 法赫德·本·贾拉维亲王代表沙特王储出席2026年达喀尔青年奥运会开幕式
items.summary: DAKAR — On behalf of Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, Prince Fahd bin Jalawi, Vice President of the Saudi Olympic and Paralympic Committee, attended the opening ceremony of the fourth Youth Olympic Games. The ceremony, held on October 31 at Abdoulaye Wade Stadium in Diamniadio, Senegal, was attended by Senegalese President Bassirou Diomaye Faye, International Olympic Committee (IOC) President Kirsty Coventry and several heads of state. **media[2788001]** The opening ceremony featured artistic and cultural performances showcasing Senegal’s history and heritage, alongside displays reflecting the values of the Olympic movement and the spirit of determination and perseverance. The event also included official addresses by the IOC President and organizing committee officials, followed by a parade of participating delegations. Prince Fahd expressed his gratitude to the Saudi leadership for its continued support of the Kingdom’s sports sector, which he said has contributed to significant advances in Saudi sports and strengthened the Kingdom’s presence at international sporting events. **media[2788000]** He highlighted the importance of Saudi Arabia’s participation in the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games, describing it as an opportunity for young Saudi athletes to gain Olympic experience, improve their technical performance and represent the Kingdom on the global stage. Prince Fahd also wished the participating Saudi athletes success, expressing hope that they would deliver outstanding performances and achieve positive results. **media[2788003]**

items.title: Saudi FM discusses maritime security with Brazil, France and Germany
items.title_zh: 沙特调频与巴西、法国和德国讨论海上安全问题
items.summary: ATLANTA — Saudi Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan held separate meetings with his counterparts from Brazil, France and Germany on the sidelines of the G20 Foreign Ministers’ Meeting, discussing bilateral relations, regional developments and threats to maritime security and global trade. During his meeting with French Minister for Europe and Foreign Affairs Jean-Noël Barrot, Prince Faisal discussed bilateral relations and recent regional developments, particularly the continued attacks by the Houthi militia on Saudi territory. The discussions also addressed threats to maritime security in the Strait of Hormuz and Bab al-Mandab and their repercussions on international trade and global supply chains. Saudi Ambassador to the United States Princess Reema bint Bandar attended the meeting. **media[2787997]** In a separate meeting with Brazilian Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira, the two ministers reviewed relations between Saudi Arabia and Brazil and discussed regional and international developments. They also emphasized the need for coordinated efforts to address threats to maritime navigation and mitigate their impact on global trade flows and supply chains. Prince Faisal also met with German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul to review bilateral relations and discuss major regional developments. Both ministers emphasized the importance of strengthening international coordination to restore security and stability in the region and safeguard maritime passages to ensure the uninterrupted flow of global trade. **media[2787999]**

items.title: King Salman issues two royal orders promoting 172 Public Prosecution members

items.summary: RIYADH — Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman has issued two royal orders promoting 172 members of the Public Prosecution across various judicial ranks. Attorney General and Chairman of the Public Prosecution Council Dr. Khalid bin Mohammed Al-Yousef expressed his gratitude to King Salman and Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman for their continued support of the Public Prosecution. He said the support reflects the leadership’s commitment to strengthening the institution and empowering its personnel. Al-Yousef emphasized that the royal trust placed in members of the Public Prosecution serves as a source of pride and motivation to further improve performance, in line with the leadership’s aspirations to safeguard rights and uphold justice.

items.title: Saudi customs record 1,147 seizures of prohibited items at border crossings
items.title_zh: 沙特海关在边境口岸查获了1,147件违禁物品
items.summary: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia's land, sea and air customs ports recorded 1,147 seizures of prohibited items as part of ongoing efforts by the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) to strengthen security and protect society from various types of contraband.The seized items included 48 types of narcotics, such as hashish, cocaine, heroin, methamphetamine and Captagon pills, in addition to 270 prohibited substances.Customs authorities also thwarted 839 smuggling attempts involving tobacco and its derivatives, along with nine cases involving cash.ZATCA reaffirmed its commitment to tightening customs controls over the Kingdom's imports and exports to safeguard society, in continued cooperation and coordination with relevant authorities.The authority also urged the public to contribute to combating smuggling and protecting society and the national economy by reporting suspected violations through its security hotline at 1910 or the international number +966 1910, as well as by email.ZATCA said reports concerning smuggling crimes and violations of the Unified Customs Law are handled with complete confidentiality, with financial rewards offered to informants whose reports are verified as accurate.

items.title: Saudi Arabia calls for lasting regional peace at Manama Dialogue
items.title_zh: 沙特阿拉伯在麦纳麦对话中呼吁实现持久的地区和平
items.summary: MANAMA — Saudi Deputy Foreign Minister Waleed Al-Khereiji reaffirmed the Kingdom's commitment to regional security and diplomatic solutions to ongoing conflicts, condemning continued Houthi attacks against Saudi Arabia and Yemen during the 22nd Manama Dialogue conference in Bahrain.Speaking at a session titled "The Consequences of Transformative Regional Conflict," Al-Khereiji stressed the urgent need to contain crises and strengthen regional security and stability amid expanding conflicts and worsening humanitarian suffering.He warned of the consequences of regional instability for maritime security, energy supplies and the global economy, emphasizing the importance of protecting countries and their populations while pursuing political settlements that address the root causes of conflicts and prevent their recurrence.Al-Khereiji said Saudi Arabia's foreign policy is based on the firm conviction that its national security is closely linked to the stability of its regional surroundings and that sustainable peace is essential for development and prosperity.He explained that the Kingdom is strengthening its capabilities to protect its security and sovereignty in accordance with international law while intensifying diplomatic efforts to resolve crises based on respect for state sovereignty, good neighborly relations and noninterference in internal affairs."Saudi Arabia continues its diplomatic efforts, in coordination with brotherly nations and partners, to reduce escalation and resolve differences through peaceful means in a way that preserves the region's security and stability," he said.Addressing developments in Yemen, Al-Khereiji reaffirmed Saudi Arabia's continued support for the internationally recognized Yemeni government and efforts to reach a comprehensive political settlement that preserves Yemen's unity and security.He condemned the continued escalation by the Houthi militia against Yemen and its people, as well as against Saudi Arabia, particularly attacks targeting civilian facilities and threats to maritime navigation.Al-Khereiji said the Houthis were seeking to undermine de-escalation efforts and diplomatic initiatives aimed at reaching a political settlement to the Yemeni crisis, while expanding the conflict and obstructing opportunities to restore regional security and stability.He also highlighted the importance of strengthening countries' resilience in the face of regional crises.In this context, he said Saudi Arabia is developing its defense capabilities, protecting critical infrastructure and vital facilities, enhancing cybersecurity and ensuring the continuity of essential services.These efforts are accompanied by closer coordination among Gulf countries and the expansion of the Kingdom's defense partnerships, he added.Concluding his remarks, Al-Khereiji reaffirmed that Saudi Arabia, under the directives of its leadership, continues to work with regional and international partners to establish a regional security framework based on stable states and just political settlements.He emphasized that these efforts aim to safeguard the right of the region's peoples to security, development and prosperity.

items.title: Air defenses intercept hostile drone in Riyadh region, no injuries reported

items.title: Where was Saudi Arabia’s first wind turbine installed?
items.title_zh: 沙特阿拉伯的第一台风力涡轮机安装在哪里？
items.summary: TURAIF — Saudi Arabia's first wind turbine for electricity generation was inaugurated by Saudi Aramco in January 2017 in Turaif, a governorate in the Northern Borders Region.The project marked an early step in the Kingdom's use of wind energy to generate electricity, with the turbine installed to supply power to Aramco's petroleum products distribution facility.Saudi Aramco evaluated four potential locations before selecting Turaif for the project.The governorate was chosen for its favorable wind resources, ease of access and availability of connections to the electricity grid, making it suitable for wind-powered electricity generation.The turbine has a maximum generation capacity of 2.75 megawatts.At the time of its inauguration, Aramco estimated that its electricity output would be sufficient to meet the needs of approximately 250 homes.The company also projected that the turbine could save the equivalent of around 19,000 barrels of oil annually by reducing reliance on conventional energy sources.The turbine stands on an 85-meter tower, with a rotor diameter of 120 meters.At their highest point, the blade tips reach approximately 145 meters above ground level.The turbine was also designed with protective specifications suited to the harsh conditions of the desert environment.The turbine was connected to the electricity distribution network serving Aramco's petroleum products distribution facility in Turaif.According to the company, the project was designed to cover the facility's entire electricity demand, with any surplus electricity supplied to the main power grid.

items.title: Saudi foreign minister discusses regional security with Russian, Canadian and EU officials
items.title_zh: 沙特外长与俄罗斯、加拿大和欧盟官员讨论地区安全问题
items.summary: ATLANTA — Saudi Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan held separate meetings with his counterparts from Russia and Canada, as well as the European Union's foreign policy chief, on the sidelines of the G20 Foreign Ministers' Meeting in Atlanta.During his meeting with Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov, Prince Faisal reviewed bilateral relations and discussed major regional developments, particularly the escalation in Yemen and continuing threats to maritime navigation through the Strait of Hormuz and Bab Al-Mandab Strait.The two ministers also explored efforts to enhance regional security and promote stability.In a separate meeting Friday, Prince Faisal met Canadian Foreign Minister Anita Anand to discuss bilateral relations and the latest developments in the region.Both sides condemned the Houthi militia's continued attacks against Saudi Arabia and emphasized the importance of efforts to achieve regional security and stability.Prince Faisal also met Kaja Kallas, the European Union's high representative for foreign affairs and security policy and vice president of the European Commission.Their discussions focused on regional and international developments, with both sides reaffirming the importance of maintaining security and stability in the region.

items.title: Air defenses intercept Houthi missiles, drones targeting Makkah, Madinah and other regions
items.title_zh: 防空系统拦截胡塞武装导弹，无人机瞄准麦加、麦地那和其他地区
items.summary: RIYADH — Air defenses intercepted and destroyed two missiles and three drones launched by the Houthi militia toward several regions of the Kingdom on Friday and Saturday, according to the Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen.Coalition spokesperson Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Maliki said air defense forces intercepted and destroyed a cruise missile launched by the Houthi militia toward the western region and a ballistic missile targeting the southern region.Al-Maliki added that three drones launched by the Houthis toward Riyadh, Makkah and Madinah were also intercepted and destroyed.The latest interceptions followed similar incidents Thursday, when Saudi air defenses intercepted and destroyed two ballistic missiles launched by the Houthis toward Riyadh and another ballistic missile targeting the Eastern Province, according to Al-Maliki.Meanwhile, Saudi Civil Defense urged citizens and residents to follow safety instructions during warning periods, including staying away from open areas and glass windows and avoiding balconies and rooftops.
